jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Transparent doll-racing animation sheet, EXACT3 columns x2 rows, six equal SQUARE cells, landscape3:2. Reference shows this doll's exact identity, outfit, body proportions, rendering and physical scale; use both images as identity and scale reference. Create new RIGHT-FACING three-quarter poses of the SAME doll. Same large vinyl doll head, rounded child doll body, face, hair, clothing details and polished painted toy aesthetic. Personality: cheerful, eager balance; preserve blonde hair buns and red bows, blue patterned short dress and white collar. Preserve her anatomical size consistently across all six cells, including identical head size. TOP ROW (3 skating frames): classic WHITE BOOT quad roller skates with FOUR wheels, wheels red #d33b2f. Smooth glide cycle: frame1 back foot pushes out behind while all wheels stay down; frame2 feet together gliding; frame3 other foot pushes. Both feet LOW near ground in every frame, no lifted running knee or raised back skate. Arms loose for balance, small forward lean. Hem must reveal both skates. BOTTOM ROW (3 pogo frames): the same doll holding ONE identical pogo design: red vertical pole, silver coil spring near bottom, black foot pegs, black handle grips, rubber tip. Both hands visibly grip handlebar at chest, both feet on pegs close to the bottom. Column1 compressed knees and squashed spring; column2 gently extended knees and stretched spring; column3 slightly tucked airborne-ready pose (do not draw her higher, game lifts it). Pogo vertical and centered in each cell, its tip on same bottom baseline as skating wheels, never cropped. Keep pole short enough to allow full doll above it; small bent-knee posture retains scale. Entire six figures including hair, wheels and tips visible with clear transparent padding between cells and on all outer edges, no overlap. No ground, shadows, props besides skates/pogo, text, labels or gridlines. Do not paste accessories on running poses; draw proper gliding and pogo stances.
